## 8. Derived Executive frame

The Executive frame, in the shape of a frame declaration (REFERENCE_FRAME
§13; P6, P0):

| Frame element | Executive |
|---|---|
| evaluation family | Is the bounded outcome and execution basis authorised? Which frames and actors are capable? Is a returned result exact and current? Which priority, current-boundary effect, disposition and next action follow from the current Product mandate? |
| subject and basis | the complete selected method cut; the exact Goals, Product, requirements, design and work authority; the current MVP or release mandate; the current workspace and checkpoint; open findings and their technical triage; the Product-selected triage policy; the proxy grant where one is used |
| material manifold | outcome, mandate, affected causal cone, evaluation inventory, frame configuration, actor envelopes, evidence obligations, returned results and technical triage, priority, boundary effect, re-entry owners and the boundary of already-authorised continuation |
| coordinates | exact method, project, outcome, mandate, authority, checkpoint, candidate, evidence, finding, triage-policy and actor identities |
| governing invariants | RF-001 to RF-017 (REFERENCE_FRAME §3); the execution relation and intake of ACTIVATION §1 with the design profile's bounded-frame conservation laws; applicable identity, carrier, assurance and release law |
| authority | the existing Product or work frame-set and decision authority, or its admitted bounded proxy; no operation or other authority arises from the label |
| evidence | live authority surfaces, frame results, Reviewer technical triage, exact candidate identity, transition evidence, coverage residuals and specialist results |
| capability envelope | enough method, Product, release or MVP, authority, workspace, triage and actor-selection competence to configure, prioritise and dispose the bounded evaluation; implementation expertise may be delegated to specialist frames |
| exclusions | candidate, Product or worktree byte mutation and implementation effects while occupying the frame; implementation ownership; silently rewriting Reviewer evidence or severity; claiming independent review without a qualifying activation; semantic reconstruction owned elsewhere; disposition outside the admitted grant |
| result | one core result (FOUNDATIONS §4 Results), the assigned priority and current-boundary effect, and one existing disposition (ACTIVATION §3 Disposition) where the basis is decidable |
| invalidation | a material change of method, authority, outcome, mandate, triage policy, checkpoint, candidate, evidence, finding, capability or topology |

The frame adds no `authorize` or `no_action` disposition. Activation is the
`activate` function of REFERENCE_FRAME §5; candidate disposition stays
exactly `accept`, `local_repair`, `re_enter` or `reject` (ACTIVATION §3,
Disposition). Priority and current-boundary effect are decision
projections, neither core results nor dispositions. If the Executive cannot
rely on a supplied severity or technical assessment, it reactivates a
capable evaluation or keeps the uncertainty; it never silently rewrites the
Reviewer result (P5, P6).

### Steel-thread delivery

The Executive sequences delivery around a steel thread: the smallest real,
runnable path from a supported Product entry to a material outcome through
the selected composition. The path is established early and widened in
bounded increments; where it already exists, the affected thread is extended
or revalidated. Increments are chosen for consequential uncertainty,
dependency and interface reach, and failure impact (P2; the generic sequencing heuristic is SPEC_METHOD §8).
The steel thread is this profile's selected strategy under the
construction relation ([ACTIVATION §1 Strategy](ACTIVATION.md#construction-relation)):
its rationale is early feedback on the end-to-end composition at the cost
of later widening; other strategies remain lawful for other
configurations; no superiority over them is claimed, and the rationale
states the objective the selection serves and its cost (P2, P6).

Early end-to-end and integration evidence prunes incompatible construction
choices before they spread; it settles the exercised interfaces, keeps
working composition, and concentrates construction on unresolved
obligations. Each passing thread establishes only the relations and
conditions actually exercised; untested branches, interaction combinations,
and refusal and recovery paths keep their material proof obligations.
Settled construction decisions are revisited when material counterevidence
invalidates their basis (P6, P4b).

During construction, focused deterministic regression and targeted
judgment probes resolve material uncertainty, and unit evidence covers
module-owned laws under the testing frames (ASSURANCE §7). Substantial,
resource-intensive user-acceptance cycles are scheduled near release or
when a bounded capability is complete enough to qualify; an early focused
user probe stays appropriate where it decides a material outcome
uncertainty (P2, ACTIVATION §7 proof cadence).

The product testing frames keep their distinct claims and govern the
necessary scenarios, independent assessments and repetitions. Qualified
results are reused while their exact subject and basis stay valid; affected
assurance is rerun when a material change invalidates it. The Executive
selects this sequence under the existing mandate and activates construction
only through the existing operation grants (P6, P4b).

# STDO Work

Deliver the smallest causally closed change authorized by one exact work basis.
The admitted re-entry point decides where work begins.

## Start With Your Own Control Intake

Read the exact own contract or intake named in the request before any general
search or project read. Bind your own permitted inputs, exclusions and return
route, then apply [Control Intake](../../references/COORDINATED_HANDOFF.md#control-intake).
This applies to issuer, recipient and direct work. Use named control routes;
do not start with directory inventories, memory searches or neighbouring
prompts. A Worker’s access never becomes its issuer’s access. Check the actual
host boundary before relying on excluded information staying unavailable.

## Choose The Entry

If receiving a coordinated packet, apply
[Receive](../../references/COORDINATED_HANDOFF.md#receive) before the general
discovery, classification or subject reads below. After validation, use this
skill's ordinary procedure within that packet; return its closed work result
through the named surface and consumer, then stop.

If the active frame coordinates this work across a material boundary, use
[Issue](../../references/COORDINATED_HANDOFF.md#issue). Select the authorized
unit from its existing carrier, bind the Worker additions of
`EXECUTIVE_BASELINE` §19 and dispatch a recipient of this same skill. The
issuer consumes [the return](../../references/COORDINATED_HANDOFF.md#evaluate-the-return)
under §12 steps 3–4 and determines required review; it does not fall through
into construction in its Executive frame. If the grant requires another
actor, a same-actor role change is insufficient.

Otherwise follow the direct path below. A sufficient direct Writer invocation
needs no added coordinator, Worker, ticket or review. The accepted frame basis
and actual authority decide; the requested mode alone grants nothing.

## Select The Product Basis

Read and apply
[`PRODUCT_BASIS.md`](../../references/PRODUCT_BASIS.md) before drafting an
execution contract or changing any surface. Continue only from its exactly-one
verified selection; that selection grants no work or mutation authority.

## Acquire The Deciding Owners

Enter through the verified definition's declared bootstrap entrypoint. Then
acquire what this work needs under the selected basis's `ACTIVATION.md`
section 2, Acquisition: a derived surface whose sources are current where one
serves the task, such as a verbatim frame of the cut, and otherwise the owning
sections that decide the task's questions. Acquire only from the exact
selected basis; a candidate source, a version-line selector or another basis
is no substitute. Acquisition is read-only and grants no role, operation or
decision; effectful work still needs the admitted contract below. Before
dependent action, return a missing binding (no available frame declaring what
the evaluation needs, or an absent or unverifiable basis) with the outcome
that section names.

## Classify From The Available Evidence

Apply the selected basis's intake and agentic-construction rules
(`SPEC_METHOD.md` sections 4 and 8, `ACTIVATION.md` section 1). Use declared source/worksite/proof tools to compute the affected owner
and authority-layer routes, the complete relevant Public serialized membership
and value delta, and accepted-design trace coverage. Bind their exact inputs,
producer, output and freshness. A file diff alone is not a Public comparison;
an existing trace is not a judgment of semantic sufficiency. Missing targets,
serialization or trace mappings remain explicit unknowns. Do not invent a
tool result or make the STDO distribution manager a worksite analyzer.

Reuse applicable computed facts and recorded classification/materiality
judgments from the existing work carrier. Check the question, subject, basis,
support and revising observation; a different role alone does not require
reclassification. Judge only the residual needed to select the smallest lawful
path and record its basis once. An unresolved owner choice stays with its owner.
Use one bounded discriminator when it can resolve a material unknown.

Distinguish a failed candidate from a changed requested outcome. If a helper
edit violates an unchanged Public requirement, reject or repair the candidate
inside the existing grant. Re-enter the requirement owner when the selected
outcome needs changed governing meaning. Candidate bytes cannot choose that
outcome or enlarge the grant.

## Establish The Work Basis

1. Establish applicable upstream work authority under the verified definition
   and immutable basis. Without it, stop before
   selecting a carrier; a ticket cannot substitute for that authority. Then
   select the first applicable source for one run-scoped execution contract:

   - reuse an exact admitted durable ticket when it covers the work;
   - otherwise require one authorized durable ticket only when work or an
     obligation needs independent state beyond its admitted sprint or, outside
     a sprint, beyond the current run;
   - otherwise use the admitted sprint plus one manifest-local iteration entry
     when the work ends by sprint close; or
   - otherwise use an intake draft for work that ends in the current run.

   Do not invoke `stdo-ticket` automatically. Absence of a ticket neither
   requires nor authorizes creating one.
2. Bind the contract's current Goal or exact work instruction, `change_intent`,
   change class, re-entry point, `target_truth`, relevant `superseded_truth`,
   `closure_law`, governing requirement and accepted design, checkpoint,
   affected relation set, write territory, evaluation criteria, non-closure
   conditions, proof surface, and one Product-bound durable result/evidence
   surface. If that result surface is unavailable or unauthorized, admission
   must refuse.
3. Validate and admit or reject that exact contract. Drafting, admission, and
   execution may occur in the same invocation, but ticket presence, `active`
   status, a generic work request, or the model's own draft cannot supply
   admission. Continue only after deterministic admission or an exact human
   override of the bounded contract. Record the Product-bound admitting
   mechanism and authority, exact contract identity or digest, decision, and
   evidence. If those coordinates are absent, return the missing authority and
   stop.
   Consume an existing exact owner instruction or admitted grant when it
   already covers this contract; cite it instead of requesting the same
   authorization again. Record the binding, not another approval round.
4. Re-enter at the first changed layer and flow forward:

   - requirement change: establish the successor/current requirement as the
     sole operative truth; supersede or withdraw a published live domain
     artifact instead of mutating it in place;
   - design change: admit the structural decision before implementation relies
     on it; or
   - realization change: prove upstream Goals, Intent, Product, requirements,
     and accepted design remain unchanged.
5. If work discovers an obligation that needs state beyond its local carrier
   boundary, do not claim closure or create a ticket without authority. Persist
   it only when the current exact grant already includes ticket-state mutation
   for that obligation. Otherwise retain it in the contract's named durable
   result/evidence surface or an already-authorized enclosing carrier, mark
   closure withheld, and return the required re-entry plus an explicit
   `stdo-ticket` route without invoking it. A conversation return alone is not
   durable evidence.

## Construct And Prove

Use the accepted Project Reference-Frame Basis to determine applicable
evaluations, including those required by an affected owner. A known false
condition omits that evaluation; an unknown condition is unresolved, not
false: it needs a bounded resolution or an explicit residual, and the claim
that depends on it is withheld until evidence or the owning decision
resolves it (ACTIVATION §1 Applicability). Missing required
results cannot count as satisfied. Availability of a frame does not require activating it.

When that basis permits direct Writer use and one sufficient context/grant
covers the outcome, construct directly without an additional coordinating
activation, Reviewer or durable ticket. Activate the coordination the
applicable configuration selects for a material dependency, authority or
context boundary. While occupying Executive, do not edit files or
Git state; the same actor must first enter a separately bound Writer activation.
An actual independence requirement still needs an independent capable actor.
One exact Writer grant may cover its declared construction, status and checkpoint
sequence. Record actual role transitions; unchanged status alone does not need
a new activation or wholesale rehash. Refresh bindings on material change.

1. Work inside the smallest coherent causal cone and exact write territory.
   Read material producers, consumers and owners across that cone within the
   access grant; narrow write territory is not a narrower reasoning boundary.
   Return cross-territory repairs to their owner.
   Preserve solution space where variation cannot change a governed property.
2. Implement and self-review the bounded change.
3. Derive tests through:

   ```text
   work carrier -> triage -> re-entry -> requirement/design/module/closure law
   ```

4. Use the cheapest focused falsifier adequate for the claim. Add integration,
   installed-development, harnessed sandbox, or live sandbox evidence only
   where the Product claim requires it. A real probabilistic boundary requires
   a live lane.
5. Reconcile authority, design, implementation, tests, and displaced rival
   paths before claiming a candidate.
   Consume established facts while their exact subject, basis, scope,
   provenance and validity apply. Function boundaries alone do not invalidate
   them; mutation, rollback, authority/basis change and actual trust boundaries
   retain their applicable checks. For material computational composition or
   recurrence, inspect the complete path and its accumulated work under the
   owning design and optional frame refinement. Qualify declared workloads and
   operational assumptions rather than inferring adequacy from local green.
   Retire superseded responsibility; retained mechanisms need a supported
   obligation, owner, purpose, scope and cost, and temporary ones a removal
   trigger. Audit affected test predicates against the supported operating and
   threat model; an excluded threat cannot require a replacement guard.
6. Return the exact candidate and stop at a delegated return boundary.
   Product-owned decision authority, or an
   authorized Executive when that profile is adopted, decides whether Product,
   qualification, release, risk, or admitted-work law requires independence
   and separately activates `stdo-review`.

For a selected repair pass, apply [the selected review flow](../../references/COORDINATED_HANDOFF.md#review-flow-from-the-selected-basis):
bind linked findings/items, exact repaired subject, failing-before/passing-after
reproduction and the declared suite. Identify tests versus any required
independent recheck honestly. Keep authorized landing separate from work
closure and release; a local repair does not automatically add a review round.

Keep reusable judgments and owner rulings in the existing carrier: exact
question, subject/basis, supporting computed evidence, actor and authority,
conclusion, scope, uncertainty and revising observation. Preserve the original
owner ruling separately from interpretation. Invalidate the affected claim
when one of the invalidators of `ACTIVATION.md` section 7 occurs; retain
unrelated valid results. Reuse does not
manufacture an owner ruling or satisfy required independent assessment.

On repricing, retain, supersede, defer or withdraw each affected obligation with
its owner/evidence links in this carrier. Present the short consequence delta;
"continue" does not accept an undisclosed architectural change. An authorized
preservation checkpoint can keep unfinished work with its predecessor,
territory, concurrent-writer disposition and durable evidence; it claims no
acceptance or publication.

Evaluate closure as the conjunction of satisfied applicable obligations,
valid supporting evidence, required judgments/rulings and absence of an active
non-closure condition. A review event is not completion. Record a satisfied
bounded result under the existing state-mutation grant; withhold only the
affected claim when a condition is missing. Qualification, publication and
consumer adoption retain their separate conditions.

## Return

Return the exact candidate/checkpoint, changed paths, affected authority,
execution-contract admission mechanism/result/evidence, focused and broader
proof, non-changes, residuals, and closed or withheld work result. Do not
claim acceptance beyond the grant, discard a surviving obligation, or silently
continue beyond a delegated return boundary.

## Control Intake

This is the first path for **issuer, recipient and direct work**. The issuer's
access is its own grant, not the Worker's. A coordinator cannot inspect the
subject merely because its Worker may do so.

1. Read the exact own contract/intake named in the request first. Bind its
   role, allowed control inputs, excluded information, operations and return
   route. Do not begin with directory listings, recursive discovery, memory
   search or neighbouring files. If the request supplies only a packet, its
   authorized control routes are the initial limit; check them against their
   authoritative grant before dependent acquisition. If no exact control
   route is supplied, use only the request's authorized discovery boundary;
   an unresolved boundary returns for clarification rather than being guessed.
2. Read the named Product Definition, accepted frame basis and applicable
   grant/admission through those control routes. An exact definition path
   removes the need to inventory surrounding directories. Verify it with the
   [compact source reader](#compact-source-acquisition) or the already-declared
   equivalent tool; do not print the manager's complete member inventory into
   the actor context. Retain the actual verification identity/result.
3. Check the active host binding before relying on an acquisition exclusion:
   what context is already supplied, which tools and scopes are actually
   enabled, how new reads are confined or supervised, and how results return.
   Use exposed capabilities and the admitted run binding, not exploration of
   home/configuration files. A fresh session is not a read boundary. If the
   required capability is absent, unknown or already violated, stop the
   dependent activation with its cause; do not claim a clean frame and
   continue. The [host binding](#host-binding) states the specific limits.
4. Enter only the branch required by that bound role. Issuer follows Issue;
   recipient follows Receive; a sufficient direct task uses the ordinary
   skill. Read additional sources only for a material question and through
   the admitted routes. The skill's general workflow never widens this intake.

## Issue

1. **Select the authorized unit.** Verify the current outcome, checkpoint,
   selected basis, accepted frame configuration and applicable grant/admission. Use
   the applicable entry if the admitted contract supplies an activation
   table. Otherwise use its sufficient authorized intake. The carrier can
   be a ticket, sprint entry or run contract. Preserve applicable existing
   grants; an absent ticket does not require creating one. A missing unit or
   material scope change returns to its owning contract/admission route.
   Work admission, an assessment grant and read-only orientation are distinct:
   apply the relation the selected operation requires, not an automatic
   execution contract for every question.
2. **Project the admitted unit.** The packet is a reference/verbatim projection
   of that unit, not a rewritten operating procedure. Use the compact bindings
   below or their equivalent in the existing carrier. Each binding points to
   an exact admitted source clause; any inlined grant or condition is quoted
   verbatim with its origin. The recipient applies the same skill to those
   bindings. Do not rewrite the skill or derive a new decision algorithm.

   | Binding | Recipient must be able to establish |
   |---|---|
   | Task | Activation/frame identity, purpose, requested skill, entry and bounded outcome |
   | Basis | Product Definition identity/path, immutable method URI and manifest digest, accepted frame basis and exact subject/checkpoint |
   | Authority | Contract/grant identity or digest, applicable admission decision/evidence, actor/role, inherited operations, mutation subject and write territory where applicable |
   | Acquisition | Authorized bootstrap/control sources, material read set and routes, tools/channels, exclusions and inline material's provenance |
   | Envelope | Required capability, context and resource limits; actual host/inheritance binding; applicable independence conditions |
   | Result | Result algebra, durable result/evidence surface, consumer, permitted return projection and any required conjunction/dependency results |
   | Continuation | Applicable predecessor's closed result, validity conditions, stop/re-entry conditions and the next decision boundary |
   | Unresolved required binding | Missing source, verification or capability; return its cause and required re-entry instead of an executable packet |

   Preserve conditional grants as conditions. Do not add inferred conditionals,
   read/effect grants, retry permissions or closure rules. An effect grant alone
   does not grant acquisition of its output. For example, project these as
   separate existing clauses, without filling a missing clause by inference:

   ```text
   Effect and its condition: <exact admitted clause reference or verbatim quote>
   Output acquisition: <exact permitted output clause reference or verbatim quote>
   Retry / result / stop: <exact admitted clause references or verbatim quotes>
   ```

   Put any proposed new interpretation outside the execution packet and return
   for its required re-entry. Calling it a derivation or a safety rule does not
   make it an inherited grant.

   A reference works only if the recipient may resolve it and its meaning is
   sufficient for this task. Names and hashes alone do not supply the missing
   contract. Inline text remains acquired information: it needs the same
   recipient eligibility and provenance as a referenced source. An issuer's
   wider access cannot authorize copying excluded information into the packet.
   Where the Product declares supported context, preflight, dispatch or evidence
   tools, use those contracts and retain their actual receipts. Do not replace
   required computation with a hand-written claim or invent tool success. A
   receipt keeps its bounded meaning; it neither grants authority nor replaces
   source/semantic judgment. Tooling availability creates no new dependency.
3. **Check the acquisition the packet prescribes.** Consider command output,
   diagnostics, logs, file lists and embedded context as well as direct reads.
   For example, requiring verbatim commit output while excluding filenames
   that command prints is a contradiction. Resolve it before dispatch using
   an already-permitted alternative, or return for the required re-entry.
   Redacting output after the recipient has seen it does not undo acquisition.
   This check establishes no general proof about arbitrary command behavior;
   an unresolved material output boundary prevents that command's use.
4. **Bind the host and dispatch.** Apply [Host Binding](#host-binding) and send
   the packet to the selected actor with the instruction to invoke this same
   skill as its recipient. Do not transfer ambient conversation by default
   where the frame excludes it. Record the dispatch/activation identity and
   actual mechanism in the existing carrier through its authorized Writer.
   If no available authorized mechanism meets the required boundary, retain
   the packet and return “not dispatched” with the missing capability. A
   prepared packet is not an active Worker or a work result.

Keep packet readiness separate from returning a response. If a required
control/source verification or capability is unavailable, return the missing
binding and the applicable incomplete/refused outcome; do not issue an
executable intake or label it ready, complete or closed. “Prepared, not
dispatched” applies only when the packet is sufficient and dispatch remains
unperformed; its consumer still checks the exact intake before using it.

The issuer remains in its coordinating frame. It acquires no mutation grant
by arranging the work. Where one same-actor role transition is sufficient and
permitted, bind and record that transition explicitly; do not pretend it
cleared information already acquired (`EXECUTIVE_BASELINE` §6 and §17).

## Evaluate The Return

The issuer checks activation identity, exact subject/basis, result variant,
evidence scope and invalidators before relying on the return. It acquires
only the return projection its own frame permits; a link to a full artifact
does not authorize reading it. A digest authenticates bytes, not their claims.

Reconcile an effect whose completion or end remains unknown before retry or
any dependent action (`ACTIVATION` §3 Effects and §5). A timeout, missing
message or lost context is not evidence that no effect occurred. Retain valid
progress; do not replay a step merely because its actor changed.

Apply the governing result/disposition relation and determine whether the
exact candidate requires independent review. Issue `stdo-review` separately
where required. Reviewer severity remains its technical assessment; the
decision owner assigns priority and boundary effect within its grant
(`EXECUTIVE_BASELINE` §12 steps 4–7). Do not turn a closed result into implicit
authority to repair, accept, publish or start the next stage.

A proposed next action is not an executable activation. Before calling it
already authorized or issuing it, bind the actual operation grant and the
settled subject/pass grouping required by that contract. If either is missing,
return the proposal and exact unresolved binding; do not presume a Writer grant
or combine unsettled passes. This checks the existing intake, not a new gate.

For an admitted sequence, each continuation uses the previous closed result
and current bindings. Retain the boundaries the contract actually declares:
neither a new human check-in at every pass nor review only at the end is a
universal rule. Refresh affected bindings on material change, not every
unchanged status observation (`ACTIVATION` §1 Roles and delegation; §7).

## Review Flow From The Selected Basis

Acquire the selected basis's `EVALUATION` §5, `TICKETS` §4 and §7, and, where
adopted, `EXECUTIVE_BASELINE` §5 and §12. Use their actual clauses. A loaded
3.0.4 skill cannot amend an older Product-selected method or silently adopt
the candidate's review cadence or optional priority policy.

Where that basis contains **Landing, closure and release**, **Declared Product
acceptance gates**, **QA cadence and repair rechecks**, and **Review findings
and bug items**, route the next decision as follows:

1. Name which decision is requested: authorized candidate landing, work
   closure, or release. Keep its actual conditions separate. A pending review
   alone is not a landing hold; no operation, access or hard-stop waiver follows.
2. Bind the exact QA subject, coverage, size and reason. Use the owning recheck
   triggers; do not automatically request a new review after every repair or
   set a review ratio. Keep test verification distinct from required independent
   review, and retain any uncovered subject.
3. Return unchanged Reviewer severity. The Executive decides priority and
   ownership directly when clear, or delegates bounded grouping/proposals to a
   triage Worker when volume warrants it; that Worker changes no assessment.
   If the basis selects the 1 highest–5 lowest convention, apply its qualitative
   anchors and explicit severity-3 downstream/blast-radius assessment. Material
   dependent impact normally calls for repair; contained local deferral needs
   a reason and owner. Keep severity 3 distinct from priority P3 and retain old
   or alternative scales on their own identities.
4. If findings need a durable carrier, use `stdo-ticket` under the exact report
   or item-update grant. Bind report ID/path, source linkage and visibility
   before the effect. No findings means no bug report; sufficient direct work
   gains no redundant ticket. A Reviewer records only its granted report and
   makes no candidate repair. The reviewed work item's ledger holds decisions
   and repair/verification provenance, not a new copy of the assessment.
5. For provisional downstream use, retain exact dependencies and uncertainty.
   Check only explicitly declared Product gates; a later material finding
   invalidates affected dependent results before further reliance. Keep other
   valid work. If a policy or boundary decision is genuinely missing, return
   that material choice rather than inventing numeric meanings or a gate.

Example: a granted Writer lands candidate C while its selected QA runs. QA
reports finding F in the named restricted report R. The Executive retains F's
severity, assigns priority and links item B on the reviewed work carrier. A
repair returns C2 with its failing-before/passing-after reproduction and
declared suite evidence. The Executive applies the selected recheck conditions:
tests may verify B when no independent recheck is required; otherwise B awaits
that exact report. Neither outcome by itself authorizes release or adopts C2
at an explicitly gated downstream boundary.

# Product Basis Selection

Use this read-only procedure before every STDO workflow skill. It selects and
verifies one Product basis; it grants no mutation, execution, review,
disposition, installation, or continuation authority.

## Procedure

1. State the requested Product scope from the exact request and Product-owned
   identities or claims. If the request does not distinguish the Product, keep
   the scope unresolved.
2. Discover candidate `stdo_<label>.json` definitions within the authorized
   workspace search boundary. A filename, current directory, nearest file, or
   directory nesting is discovery evidence only and cannot select a Product or
   imply composition.
3. Determine applicability from each definition's Product-definition identity
   and its Product-owned `what`, `how`, `ticketing`, bounded-context, and
   explicit composition bindings. A path is selecting evidence only when the
   definition itself binds it to the requested Product scope.
4. Require exactly one applicable definition. For zero applicable definitions,
   return the unresolved scope. For multiple applicable definitions, return
   every remaining definition identity and path and request Product-scope
   disambiguation. Do not choose by proximity, familiarity, recency, or label.
5. Verify the selected definition read-only:

   ```sh
   stdo status --definition <selected-definition> --verify
   ```

   Require the reported definition path and identity, immutable basis URI, and
   manifest SHA-256 to match the selected definition, with `installed: true`,
   `valid: true`, and no failures. Do not sync, adopt, install, fall back to
   mutable source, or select a nearby Product during this procedure.
6. Return the requested Product scope, definition identity and path, immutable
   basis URI or cut, manifest SHA-256, and verification result. Only then may
   the calling skill continue under its own effect and authority boundary.

Zero definitions, multiple applicable definitions, failed verification, or any
identity, path, basis, manifest, installation, or validity mismatch stops the
calling skill before effects. Report the exact candidates or mismatch and the
required re-entry; do not repair it implicitly.

## Read A Member From That Basis

After the selected basis has verified, resolve each required member through
that same immutable basis. A route consists of the member's package-relative
path and, where needed, a heading anchor within it. For example:

```sh
STDO_BASIS_URI='stdo://releases/<selected-immutable-cut>/'
stdo resolve "${STDO_BASIS_URI}manifest.json"
stdo resolve "${STDO_BASIS_URI}standards/ACTIVATION.md"
```

Use the basis URI returned by the verified Product Definition. Read the
manifest whose digest equals that definition's `manifest_sha256`. Require
`ACTIVATION.md` in its standards inventory and require the resolved file's
SHA-256 to equal that member's declared digest. Apply the same check to every
other selected member. The resolver's returned URI must equal the requested
URI, and its path must be in that verified installation. A path alone proves
neither membership nor content identity.

Resolve the member without its fragment, then locate the exact anchor in
those verified bytes; for example, `#7-closed-result-and-reuse` selects
ACTIVATION's reuse owner. A missing member, anchor, manifest mismatch or
content mismatch leaves the route unresolved. Acquire no replacement from a
checkout, moving selector, later cut or neighbouring Product. A frame is a
member too: verify its own bytes and the local sources and section digests
listed in `standards/frames/FRAME_INPUTS.json` before treating it as current.
This identity check does not establish semantic fidelity or task sufficiency.

Return the exact basis URI and manifest digest with each acquired member,
its member digest, selected anchor and any unresolved dependency. The
calling skill retains its own authority and effect boundary.

## 11. Derived generic specialist frame set

The profile declares the following generic families for Product work. Each
row is an evaluation archetype, not a complete frame declaration
(REFERENCE_FRAME §13). An adopting project binds, for every activated

The family labels resolve inside

REFERENCE_FRAME, under the selected basis. Under bounded-context semantic

| Family | Evaluation family and exact subject | Governing authority and permitted output | Immediate falsifier |

The basis is the current Intent, Product, requirements, acceptance meaning and exact Product coordinates. | Product and requirement authority keep meaning and acceptance. The frame returns only a bounded evaluation result and evidence. | Design, code, tests, a predecessor's behaviour or a local convention changes Product meaning or substitutes another Product subject. |

The families are non-hierarchical and may overlap (RF-008, RF-009).
Product does not outrank Design by frame topology; Product authority
already governs constitutional meaning. Owner gains no authority over
Entity or Operator by being a broader frame. Proof does not become Reviewer,
acceptance or disposition authority. The existing authority graph stays in
control (P6).

### Family dispositions

For each governed outcome the known evaluation inventory (REFERENCE_FRAME
§8) disposes every family as one of (P2, P6, P5):

- instantiated by one or more exact frame declarations or authoritative
  acquisition paths, because the family is material;
- evidenced as non-material to the exact outcome by the authority capable
  of that determination; or
- kept as an explicit uncovered, conditional, conflicted or `out_of_frame`
  residual.

The absence of a named file, component, runtime object or actor is no
evidence that a family is non-material. Conversely, adopting this profile
does not require a project to create twelve components or to activate
twelve frames for every task (P2, P1).

### Refinement and conjunction

When a generic frame is recursively refined, each child declaration records
its parent contract, purpose, material entities, identity and lifecycle
relations, semantic owners, direct sibling seams, applicable invariants and
prohibited competing paths. Refinement opens only for a material
distinction needed to close the parent evaluation. It is a frame dependency
relation, not an organisational or runtime hierarchy (P2, P4a; ACTIVATION
§4).

Coverage records the union of admissible observations the activated frames
contribute. A composite claim takes the value of its declared conjunction
under
[FOUNDATIONS §4 Conjunction of results](FOUNDATIONS.md#conjunction-of-results),
Reported value. This profile's declared rule makes each material
cross-frame seam a mandatory result or required coverage: the seam
preserves, or lawfully translates, exact identity, coordinate and basis,
carried value or evidence, lifecycle scope, authority and provenance
([REFERENCE_FRAME §6](REFERENCE_FRAME.md#evidence-or-coordinate-translation)
for translation). Each case of a seam enters the conjunction as that
section states (P4a, P5):

| Seam case | Input of the conjunction and value |
|---|---|
| no closed result applicable to the composite: not evaluated, or its only result is stale or bound to another subject or basis | a planned assessment without a closed result, a gap with no value of its own (FOUNDATIONS §4, the second input and Stale results) |
| a material seam that no planned assessment addresses | uncovered coverage, a gap with no value of its own (the third input) |
| evaluated and found not to preserve or lawfully translate what the rule requires | the seam's own result: `falsified`, or the outcome and core value that [REFERENCE_FRAME §5](REFERENCE_FRAME.md#5-method-functions) gives a refused translation by its cause |
| evaluated, with evidence that cannot decide it | `indeterminate` |
| its evaluation needs a translation or relation that no frame declares | `out_of_frame` |
| evaluated on a stale, advanced, ambiguous or mismatched basis | `invalid_basis` for its own predicate ([RF-005](REFERENCE_FRAME.md#rf-005-exact-basis-and-coordinates)), held as a returned result |

A composite with any of these cases is never `satisfied`; it reports the
non-satisfied value that FOUNDATIONS §4, Reported value, gives, with each
gap recorded by kind. Which non-satisfied value it reports where several
are returned is the conjunction rule the adopting project declares (§19
Project-basis additions). This profile's own declared choice is that no
frame is selected as dominant.

The set imports no consumer-specific frame, runtime role, architectural
topology or renamed local substitute. A consumer may declare such frames
under its own Product or accepted-design authority when they are material;
they are not part of this baseline (P2, P6).

### Relation to the testing and interface frames

Where this set is adopted, the product testing frames of ASSURANCE §7 supply
claim-congruent evidence to one or more Proof evaluations. Proof is not a
testing hierarchy or an aggregate-green frame: user-acceptance, end-to-end,
integration and unit results keep their distinct claims and coordinates (P6,
P4a).

The end-to-end interface integration frame (ASSURANCE §13) relates the
Public Boundary, Design, Operator, Owner and Proof families to the
integration, end-to-end and user-acceptance frames. Its computational
whole-path evaluation composes the selected interface claims with Operator,
Owner, Reuse/Foundation and Proof. Neither adds a thirteenth family, a fifth
testing type, a role or a universal activation gate (P2).

# STDO Work

Deliver the smallest causally closed change authorized by one exact work basis.
The admitted re-entry point decides where work begins.

## Start With Your Own Control Intake

Read the exact own contract or intake named in the request before any general
search or project read. Bind your own permitted inputs, exclusions and return
route, then apply [Control Intake](../../references/COORDINATED_HANDOFF.md#control-intake).
This applies to issuer, recipient and direct work. Use named control routes;
do not start with directory inventories, memory searches or neighbouring
prompts. A Worker’s access never becomes its issuer’s access. Check the actual
host boundary before relying on excluded information staying unavailable.

## Choose The Entry

If receiving a coordinated packet, apply
[Receive](../../references/COORDINATED_HANDOFF.md#receive) before the general
discovery, classification or subject reads below. After validation, use this
skill's ordinary procedure within that packet; return its closed work result
through the named surface and consumer, then stop.

If the active frame coordinates this work across a material boundary, use
[Issue](../../references/COORDINATED_HANDOFF.md#issue). Select the authorized
unit from its existing carrier, bind the Worker additions of
`EXECUTIVE_BASELINE` §19 and dispatch a recipient of this same skill. The
issuer consumes [the return](../../references/COORDINATED_HANDOFF.md#evaluate-the-return)
under §12 steps 3–4 and determines required review; it does not fall through
into construction in its Executive frame. If the grant requires another
actor, a same-actor role change is insufficient.

Otherwise follow the direct path below. A sufficient direct Writer invocation
needs no added coordinator, Worker, ticket or review. The accepted frame basis
and actual authority decide; the requested mode alone grants nothing.

## Select The Product Basis

Read and apply
[`PRODUCT_BASIS.md`](../../references/PRODUCT_BASIS.md) before drafting an
execution contract or changing any surface. Continue only from its exactly-one
verified selection; that selection grants no work or mutation authority.

## Acquire The Deciding Owners

Enter through the verified definition's declared bootstrap entrypoint. Then
acquire what this work needs under the selected basis's `ACTIVATION.md`
section 2, Acquisition: a derived surface whose sources are current where one
serves the task, such as a verbatim frame of the cut, and otherwise the owning
sections that decide the task's questions. Acquire only from the exact
selected basis; a candidate source, a version-line selector or another basis
is no substitute. Acquisition is read-only and grants no role, operation or
decision; effectful work still needs the admitted contract below. Before
dependent action, return a missing binding (no available frame declaring what
the evaluation needs, or an absent or unverifiable basis) with the outcome
that section names.

## Classify From The Available Evidence

Apply the selected basis's intake and agentic-construction rules
(`SPEC_METHOD.md` sections 4 and 8, `ACTIVATION.md` section 1). Use declared source/worksite/proof tools to compute the affected owner
and authority-layer routes, the complete relevant Public serialized membership
and value delta, and accepted-design trace coverage. Bind their exact inputs,
producer, output and freshness. A file diff alone is not a Public comparison;
an existing trace is not a judgment of semantic sufficiency. Missing targets,
serialization or trace mappings remain explicit unknowns. Do not invent a
tool result or make the STDO distribution manager a worksite analyzer.

Reuse applicable computed facts and recorded classification/materiality
judgments from the existing work carrier. Check the question, subject, basis,
support and revising observation; a different role alone does not require
reclassification. Judge only the residual needed to select the smallest lawful
path and record its basis once. An unresolved owner choice stays with its owner.
Use one bounded discriminator when it can resolve a material unknown.

Distinguish a failed candidate from a changed requested outcome. If a helper
edit violates an unchanged Public requirement, reject or repair the candidate
inside the existing grant. Re-enter the requirement owner when the selected
outcome needs changed governing meaning. Candidate bytes cannot choose that
outcome or enlarge the grant.

## Establish The Work Basis

1. Establish applicable upstream work authority under the verified definition
   and immutable basis. Without it, stop before
   selecting a carrier; a ticket cannot substitute for that authority. Then
   select the first applicable source for one run-scoped execution contract:

   - reuse an exact admitted durable ticket when it covers the work;
   - otherwise require one authorized durable ticket only when work or an
     obligation needs independent state beyond its admitted sprint or, outside
     a sprint, beyond the current run;
   - otherwise use the admitted sprint plus one manifest-local iteration entry
     when the work ends by sprint close; or
   - otherwise use an intake draft for work that ends in the current run.

   Do not invoke `stdo-ticket` automatically. Absence of a ticket neither
   requires nor authorizes creating one.
2. Bind the contract's current Goal or exact work instruction, `change_intent`,
   change class, re-entry point, `target_truth`, relevant `superseded_truth`,
   `closure_law`, governing requirement and accepted design, checkpoint,
   affected relation set, write territory, evaluation criteria, non-closure
   conditions, proof surface, and one Product-bound durable result/evidence
   surface. If that result surface is unavailable or unauthorized, admission
   must refuse.
3. Validate and admit or reject that exact contract. Drafting, admission, and
   execution may occur in the same invocation, but ticket presence, `active`
   status, a generic work request, or the model's own draft cannot supply
   admission. Continue only after deterministic admission or an exact human
   override of the bounded contract. Record the Product-bound admitting
   mechanism and authority, exact contract identity or digest, decision, and
   evidence. If those coordinates are absent, return the missing authority and
   stop.
   Consume an existing exact owner instruction or admitted grant when it
   already covers this contract; cite it instead of requesting the same
   authorization again. Record the binding, not another approval round.
4. Re-enter at the first changed layer and flow forward:

   - requirement change: establish the successor/current requirement as the
     sole operative truth; supersede or withdraw a published live domain
     artifact instead of mutating it in place;
   - design change: admit the structural decision before implementation relies
     on it; or
   - realization change: prove upstream Goals, Intent, Product, requirements,
     and accepted design remain unchanged.
5. If work discovers an obligation that needs state beyond its local carrier
   boundary, do not claim closure or create a ticket without authority. Persist
   it only when the current exact grant already includes ticket-state mutation
   for that obligation. Otherwise retain it in the contract's named durable
   result/evidence surface or an already-authorized enclosing carrier, mark
   closure withheld, and return the required re-entry plus an explicit
   `stdo-ticket` route without invoking it. A conversation return alone is not
   durable evidence.

## Construct And Prove

Use the accepted Project Reference-Frame Basis to determine applicable
evaluations, including those required by an affected owner. A known false
condition omits that evaluation; an unknown condition is unresolved, not
false: it needs a bounded resolution or an explicit residual, and the claim
that depends on it is withheld until evidence or the owning decision
resolves it (ACTIVATION §1 Applicability). Missing required
results cannot count as satisfied. Availability of a frame does not require activating it.

When that basis permits direct Writer use and one sufficient context/grant
covers the outcome, construct directly without an additional coordinating
activation, Reviewer or durable ticket. Activate the coordination the
applicable configuration selects for a material dependency, authority or
context boundary. While occupying Executive, do not edit files or
Git state; the same actor must first enter a separately bound Writer activation.
An actual independence requirement still needs an independent capable actor.
One exact Writer grant may cover its declared construction, status and checkpoint
sequence. Record actual role transitions; unchanged status alone does not need
a new activation or wholesale rehash. Refresh bindings on material change.

1. Work inside the smallest coherent causal cone and exact write territory.
   Read material producers, consumers and owners across that cone within the
   access grant; narrow write territory is not a narrower reasoning boundary.
   Return cross-territory repairs to their owner.
   Preserve solution space where variation cannot change a governed property.
2. Implement and self-review the bounded change.
3. Derive tests through:

   ```text
   work carrier -> triage -> re-entry -> requirement/design/module/closure law
   ```

4. Use the cheapest focused falsifier adequate for the claim. Add integration,
   installed-development, harnessed sandbox, or live sandbox evidence only
   where the Product claim requires it. A real probabilistic boundary requires
   a live lane.
5. Reconcile authority, design, implementation, tests, and displaced rival
   paths before claiming a candidate.
   Consume established facts while their exact subject, basis, scope,
   provenance and validity apply. Function boundaries alone do not invalidate
   them; mutation, rollback, authority/basis change and actual trust boundaries
   retain their applicable checks. For material computational composition or
   recurrence, inspect the complete path and its accumulated work under the
   owning design and optional frame refinement. Qualify declared workloads and
   operational assumptions rather than inferring adequacy from local green.
   Retire superseded responsibility; retained mechanisms need a supported
   obligation, owner, purpose, scope and cost, and temporary ones a removal
   trigger. Audit affected test predicates against the supported operating and
   threat model; an excluded threat cannot require a replacement guard.
6. Return the exact candidate and stop at a delegated return boundary.
   Product-owned decision authority, or an
   authorized Executive when that profile is adopted, decides whether Product,
   qualification, release, risk, or admitted-work law requires independence
   and separately activates `stdo-review`.

For a selected repair pass, apply [the selected review flow](../../references/COORDINATED_HANDOFF.md#review-flow-from-the-selected-basis):
bind linked findings/items, exact repaired subject, failing-before/passing-after
reproduction and the declared suite. Identify tests versus any required
independent recheck honestly. Keep authorized landing separate from work
closure and release; a local repair does not automatically add a review round.

Keep reusable judgments and owner rulings in the existing carrier: exact
question, subject/basis, supporting computed evidence, actor and authority,
conclusion, scope, uncertainty and revising observation. Preserve the original
owner ruling separately from interpretation. Invalidate the affected claim
when one of the invalidators of `ACTIVATION.md` section 7 occurs; retain
unrelated valid results. Reuse does not
manufacture an owner ruling or satisfy required independent assessment.

On repricing, retain, supersede, defer or withdraw each affected obligation with
its owner/evidence links in this carrier. Present the short consequence delta;
"continue" does not accept an undisclosed architectural change. An authorized
preservation checkpoint can keep unfinished work with its predecessor,
territory, concurrent-writer disposition and durable evidence; it claims no
acceptance or publication.

Evaluate closure as the conjunction of satisfied applicable obligations,
valid supporting evidence, required judgments/rulings and absence of an active
non-closure condition. A review event is not completion. Record a satisfied
bounded result under the existing state-mutation grant; withhold only the
affected claim when a condition is missing. Qualification, publication and
consumer adoption retain their separate conditions.

## Return

Return the exact candidate/checkpoint, changed paths, affected authority,
execution-contract admission mechanism/result/evidence, focused and broader
proof, non-changes, residuals, and closed or withheld work result. Do not
claim acceptance beyond the grant, discard a surviving obligation, or silently
continue beyond a delegated return boundary.

## Control Intake

This is the first path for **issuer, recipient and direct work**. The issuer's
access is its own grant, not the Worker's. A coordinator cannot inspect the
subject merely because its Worker may do so.

1. Read the exact own contract/intake named in the request first. Bind its
   role, allowed control inputs, excluded information, operations and return
   route. Do not begin with directory listings, recursive discovery, memory
   search or neighbouring files. If the request supplies only a packet, its
   authorized control routes are the initial limit; check them against their
   authoritative grant before dependent acquisition. If no exact control
   route is supplied, use only the request's authorized discovery boundary;
   an unresolved boundary returns for clarification rather than being guessed.
2. Read the named Product Definition, accepted frame basis and applicable
   grant/admission through those control routes. An exact definition path
   removes the need to inventory surrounding directories. Verify it with the
   [compact source reader](#compact-source-acquisition) or the already-declared
   equivalent tool; do not print the manager's complete member inventory into
   the actor context. Retain the actual verification identity/result.
3. Check the active host binding before relying on an acquisition exclusion:
   what context is already supplied, which tools and scopes are actually
   enabled, how new reads are confined or supervised, and how results return.
   Use exposed capabilities and the admitted run binding, not exploration of
   home/configuration files. A fresh session is not a read boundary. If the
   required capability is absent, unknown or already violated, stop the
   dependent activation with its cause; do not claim a clean frame and
   continue. The [host binding](#host-binding) states the specific limits.
4. Enter only the branch required by that bound role. Issuer follows Issue;
   recipient follows Receive; a sufficient direct task uses the ordinary
   skill. Read additional sources only for a material question and through
   the admitted routes. The skill's general workflow never widens this intake.

## Receive

Do this **before the skill's general discovery, classification or subject
reads**, and before effects. The packet permits only its authorized control
reads while activation is being checked; it does not validate itself.

1. Identify the packet's requested frame, consumer and acquisition boundary.
   Read only the named, authorized control inputs needed to verify it: the
   Product Definition, exact installed basis, accepted frame basis, contract/grant,
   applicable admission evidence and required predecessor result. Apply
   [Product Basis Selection](PRODUCT_BASIS.md) inside that search boundary;
   do not broaden discovery to find a more convenient definition. If these
   control reads cannot lawfully resolve the binding, return the mismatch or
   unavailable input without reading the work subject.
2. Compare the actual subject/checkpoint, contract, admission, actor/grants,
   permitted acquisition and required host properties with the packet. Check
   referenced digests/currentness and predecessor validity. Check commands
   and inline material against the same recipient boundary as the issuer.
   A known mismatch returns `activation_refusal` with its cause and the core
   result prescribed by `ACTIVATION` §3; do not manufacture a Worker result
   for an activation that never occurred. Keep an unresolved required binding
   unresolved and return the owning missing-input/capability re-entry.
3. On a valid binding, run this skill's ordinary procedure within the packet's
   frame and grant. Reuse the verified selection and still-valid facts; do not
   ask for admission again merely because a new actor received the work. A
   request to edit, run a command or read another source still needs the
   operation/acquisition authority already bound to it.
4. Record the skill's closed result on the named surface within its write
   grant, then send the permitted return projection to the named consumer.
   A read-only recipient returns through the declared read-only channel; an
   authorized recorder owns any required persistent write. Include exact
   subject/basis, evidence routes, residuals, validity and effect uncertainty.
   If the named result relation cannot be fulfilled, report the obstruction;
   do not redirect the result to an arbitrary file or claim closure. Stop at
   the packet's return boundary.

# Product Basis Selection

Use this read-only procedure before every STDO workflow skill. It selects and
verifies one Product basis; it grants no mutation, execution, review,
disposition, installation, or continuation authority.

## Procedure

1. State the requested Product scope from the exact request and Product-owned
   identities or claims. If the request does not distinguish the Product, keep
   the scope unresolved.
2. Discover candidate `stdo_<label>.json` definitions within the authorized
   workspace search boundary. A filename, current directory, nearest file, or
   directory nesting is discovery evidence only and cannot select a Product or
   imply composition.
3. Determine applicability from each definition's Product-definition identity
   and its Product-owned `what`, `how`, `ticketing`, bounded-context, and
   explicit composition bindings. A path is selecting evidence only when the
   definition itself binds it to the requested Product scope.
4. Require exactly one applicable definition. For zero applicable definitions,
   return the unresolved scope. For multiple applicable definitions, return
   every remaining definition identity and path and request Product-scope
   disambiguation. Do not choose by proximity, familiarity, recency, or label.
5. Verify the selected definition read-only:

   ```sh
   stdo status --definition <selected-definition> --verify
   ```

   Require the reported definition path and identity, immutable basis URI, and
   manifest SHA-256 to match the selected definition, with `installed: true`,
   `valid: true`, and no failures. Do not sync, adopt, install, fall back to
   mutable source, or select a nearby Product during this procedure.
6. Return the requested Product scope, definition identity and path, immutable
   basis URI or cut, manifest SHA-256, and verification result. Only then may
   the calling skill continue under its own effect and authority boundary.

Zero definitions, multiple applicable definitions, failed verification, or any
identity, path, basis, manifest, installation, or validity mismatch stops the
calling skill before effects. Report the exact candidates or mismatch and the
required re-entry; do not repair it implicitly.

## Read A Member From That Basis

After the selected basis has verified, resolve each required member through
that same immutable basis. A route consists of the member's package-relative
path and, where needed, a heading anchor within it. For example:

```sh
STDO_BASIS_URI='stdo://releases/<selected-immutable-cut>/'
stdo resolve "${STDO_BASIS_URI}manifest.json"
stdo resolve "${STDO_BASIS_URI}standards/ACTIVATION.md"
```

Use the basis URI returned by the verified Product Definition. Read the

## 7. Product testing frame set

### Terms

A testing frame is a frame (REFERENCE_FRAME §1) whose evaluation executes
or observes a declared subject to discriminate one exact claim through an
explicit oracle, evidence population, path boundary and falsification
condition. A test file, suite, runner, fixture, scenario label, coverage
percentage or actor does not become a testing frame by existing. A testing
frame's authority is bounded by the claim actually exercised; test count,
assertion count, source coverage, runtime duration and framework category
do not widen it (P6, P1).

An authoritative Product path is the declared ordinary causal composition
from a supported user or public entry, through the exact selected
interfaces, owners, state transitions, effects, persistence and recovery
boundaries, to the outcome projection the Product claim requires.
Producing an expected output through a bypass, an obsolete executor, a
test-only seam, an undeclared fallback or a competing authority falsifies
path conformance even when the output value is equal (P6, P3).

Material combinatorial complexity is the claim-relative population of
independent dimensions and interactions whose combinations can change an
outcome, violate an invariant, select another authority path or expose a
failure. At unit altitude it includes module-owned laws, behaviour at the
public module contract included, with their algebraic operators,
calculation regimes, states, transitions, boundary classes and failure
cases. Cross-participant interface, Product, persistence, configuration and
user-role combinations belong to the integration, end-to-end or
user-acceptance frames; they are not mocked away and counted as unit
evidence (P2, P6).

### The set

Where the governing frame configuration (PRODUCT_DEFINITION §7) or the
admitted work authority selects testing frames for a Product promotion,
closure or release-assurance claim, testing is configured as a
claim-relative set of testing frames. Placement in this member makes the
set, and the law of §8 to §13 that serves it, available; it adopts nothing,
and each activation is decided by ACTIVATION §1 (Applicability). The kind
of runner does not select the frame; the evaluated claim, subject, path,
population, oracle and falsification boundary do (P6, P2). Each frame's `invalidation` row,
here and in §13, lists named instances of the material input change or
the changed basis of
[ACTIVATION §7](ACTIVATION.md#7-closed-result-and-reuse); it adds no
other kind of invalidator. The ordinary configuration holds four
distinct frames:

- user acceptance evaluates the Product outcome from the user's supported
  frame;
- end to end evaluates the complete runnable causal realisation of that
  outcome;
- integration evaluates one material composition boundary and its
  interaction population; and
- unit evaluates one module-owned law; internal combinatorial complexity
  decides the proportional size and strategy of that evidence, not whether
  the law is eligible for unit proof.

They add no role, stage, authority or testing hierarchy. Their ordinary
evidence topology assigns each claim to its congruent frame (P6, P4a):

```text
Product and accepted design
  |- user-outcome claims -> user-acceptance frames
  |- runnable causal-path claims -> end-to-end frames
  |- composition-boundary claims -> integration frames
  `- module-owned laws -> unit frames

bound results -> declared conjunction -> Product or release disposition
```

The fan-out assigns claims to evidence; it is neither an authority
hierarchy nor a claim that one frame decomposes into another. Evidence
may relate through declared conjunction
([FOUNDATIONS §4 Conjunction of results](FOUNDATIONS.md#conjunction-of-results)),
translation (REFERENCE_FRAME §6), falsification and re-entry (P4a). A
broader frame cannot make a module-owned
law true, and any number of narrower green frames cannot establish an
unevaluated Product composition or user outcome (EVALUATION §1, the weaker
property never substitutes for the claimed one).

The frames may overlap, and one execution may supply evidence to several of
them; every result stays bound to its own claim. A label such as `UAT`,
`E2E`, `integration` or `unit` has no assurance value without the
corresponding frame declaration (P1, P6). Each frame below is given in the
shape of a frame declaration (REFERENCE_FRAME §13); "core result", here
and in §13, is a value of the core result algebra of
[FOUNDATIONS §4 Results](FOUNDATIONS.md#results), recorded with the
predicate the frame's claim states.

### User-acceptance frame

(P6, P2)

| evaluation family | Can a declared user, with the user's admitted capability and information, obtain the exact Product-defined outcome through the supported ordinary Product surface? |
| subject and basis | the exact deployed, installed or otherwise runnable Product form the claim names; current Product, requirement, UX, identity, policy and acceptance authority; the declared user role, environment, and harnessed or live sandbox mode (§2) |
| material manifold | user goal, supported entry surfaces, permissions, inputs, Product configuration, ordinary dependencies, any declared external-worker or transport substitution boundary, user-visible state and outputs, refusal and recovery behaviour, and the acceptance interval |
| coordinates | exact Product and artifact identity, install, user role, capability, configuration, dependency realisation, harnessed or live mode, data, workspace, invocation, time, outcome and scenario identity |
| governing invariants | the applicable Product and requirement outcomes; supported-interface, identity, UX, safety, persistence and release law; RF-001 to RF-017; EVALUATION §1, §2, §3, §6 and §7 (proof target, evidence separation, assurance-boundary congruence, freeze and post-exposure revision, comparison, method qualification) |
| authority | bounded evaluation only; the frame mints no Product meaning or acceptance authority, and an automated actor does not become the human or Product acceptance owner |
| evidence | actual supported-surface requests and responses, user-visible projections, durable side effects where claimed, refusals, recovery observations, scenario records, exact-subject identity, and the declared live or substituted dependency identity |
| capability envelope | ability to operate the Product as the declared user would, perceive the material outcome and refusal surfaces, and distinguish hidden setup or unsupported assistance |

claim is that a user can use the Product. It may be automated only when the
automation faithfully occupies the declared user frame and gains no path or
capability that user lacks. Automation can execute acceptance evidence; it
cannot assume acceptance authority (P6; EVALUATION §5).

recorded or injected external worker or transport limits the result to the
composed Product relations actually exercised; it does not prove that the
live external boundary works. When a Product or release claim depends on
real external compute or transport, live sandbox UAT is mandatory for that
claim; unit, integration, semantic and end-to-end evidence that uses the
substitute, and harnessed UAT green, are not sufficient (P6, P5).

to end because it starts and finishes in one process, crosses many lines or
carries an end-to-end label (P6, P1).
